consent.title: Privacy & Consent
consent.subtitle: Before we begin, here is how we protect your child's data.
consent.promiseTitle: Your child's homework stays on this device
consent.promiseBody: Photos, OCR text, written answers, and AI explanations are processed on this phone or tablet. They are not sent to our servers.
consent.detailPhotos: • Homework photos never leave the device.
consent.detailAnswers: • Typed or written answers stay local.
consent.detailTelemetry: • Anonymous app-health telemetry is optional and starts off.
consent.deviceOnlyBody: Photos, homework questions, and answers are processed entirely on your device. Nothing is uploaded to any server. Your child's data never leaves this phone.
consent.telemetryBody: Helps us fix crashes and download issues. It never includes photos, OCR text, or your child's answers.
consent.telemetryToggleOff: No crash reports will be sent
consent.accept: I agree to the privacy policy
